question: What is the URA Schools Tax Curriculum and what educational resources are available for secondary schools in Uganda?
answer: The URA Schools Tax Curriculum is a joint educational initiative between the Uganda Revenue Authority (URA), the National Curriculum Development Centre (NCDC), and the Ministry of Education and Sports (MoES) aimed at integrating taxation and civic tax literacy into secondary school education. Official teaching syllabi, textbooks, training manuals, and teacher orientation guides are published across two distinct academic levels: Ordinary Level (O-Level) for S1 to S4 students, and Advanced Level (A-Level) for S5 and S6 students.

question: What specific books, manuals, and syllabi are available under the A-Level Tax Curriculum download archives?
answer: Under URA's A-Level Tax Curriculum download archive at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/a-level-tax-curriculum/: 1) A-Level Economics - Resource Book (34 MB PDF, 971+ downloads) — comprehensive compendium of economic principles, fiscal policy, public revenue, and Ugandan tax systems; 2) A-Level - Entrepreneurship Syllabus (3 MB PDF, 1,191+ downloads) — curriculum structure for teaching business enterprise, financial records, and tax compliance; 3) A-Level Economics Syllabus - ORIENTATION MANUAL (5.92 MB PDF, 457+ downloads) — teacher pedagogical guide; 4) A-Level Economics Syllabus Teachers Guide (5 MB PDF, 442+ downloads); 5) A-Level Economics - Syllabus (4 MB PDF, 801+ downloads).

question: What specific textbooks, manuals, and syllabi are available under the O-Level Tax Curriculum download archives?
answer: Under URA's O-Level Tax Curriculum download archive at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/o-level-tax-curriculum/: 1) O-Level - Entrepreneurship Education TextBook (4.84 MB PDF, 3,299+ downloads) — core student instructional textbook covering practical business startup, bookkeeping, and URA tax procedures; 2) O-Level - Entrepreneurship Education Training Manual (2.06 MB PDF, 504+ downloads) — practical workshop manual; 3) O-Level - Entrepreneurship Education Teachers Guide (4.64 MB PDF, 585+ downloads); 4) O-Level - Entrepreneurship Syllabus (3.33 MB PDF, 377+ downloads).

question: How can secondary schools and educators access and implement URA tax education curriculum materials?
answer: Educators, school proprietors, and students can download all curriculum materials completely free of charge from the URA web portal under Download Categories at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/a-level-tax-curriculum/, https://ura.go.ug/download-category/o-level-tax-curriculum/, and https://ura.go.ug/download-category/taxation-handbook/. These resources are officially incorporated into classroom teaching for Economics, Commerce, and Entrepreneurship Education across Ugandan secondary schools, supporting the national competence-based curriculum.
